// This probe is copied outside the module and compiled against the candidate
// workspace by schema_monitor.py. Keeping it as .txt avoids creating a package.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/checkin"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/commands"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/ddm"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/ddmproto"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/errors"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/other"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/profiles"
	_ "github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/status"
	"github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apple-dm/devicemanagement/schema/support"
)

type probe struct {
	Family     string `json:"family"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	OS         string `json:"os"`
	Version    string `json:"version"`
	Context    string `json:"context"`
	Supported  bool   `json:"supported"`
	Deprecated bool   `json:"deprecated"`
}

func main() {
	if err := check(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func check() error {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("usage: support-probe cases.json")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var cases []probe
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	failed := 0
	for _, p := range cases {
		entry := support.Lookup(p.Family, p.Path)
		if entry == nil {
			fmt.Printf("missing support entry %s/%s\n", p.Family, p.Path)
			failed++
			continue
		}
		version, err := support.ParseVersion(p.Version)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target := support.Target{OS: support.OS(p.OS), Version: version, Channel: support.ChannelDevice, Supervised: true, DEP: true, UserApproved: true}
		switch p.Context {
		case "user":
			target.Channel = support.ChannelUser
		case "unsupervised":
			target.Supervised = false
		case "non-dep":
			target.DEP = false
		case "not-user-approved":
			target.UserApproved = false
		case "shared-device":
			target.SharedIPad = true
		case "shared-user":
			target.SharedIPad = true
			target.Channel = support.ChannelUser
		case "user-enrollment":
			target.UserEnrollment = true
		}
		got := entry.Check(target)
		if got.Supported != p.Supported || got.Deprecated != p.Deprecated {
			fmt.Printf("%s/%s %s %s %s: supported=%t deprecated=%t, expected %t/%t: %s\n", p.Family, p.Path, p.OS, p.Version, p.Context, got.Supported, got.Deprecated, p.Supported, p.Deprecated, got.Reason)
			failed++
		}
	}
	if failed > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%d of %d source-derived support probes failed", failed, len(cases))
	}
	fmt.Printf("Passed %d source-derived support boundary/context probes\n", len(cases))
	return nil
}
